data.subject: Checking In
data.body:
Dear Arhaam,

I hope you are doing well.

I just wanted to check in and see how things are going on your side. If
there are any updates or tasks that require my attention, please let me
know so I can take care of them as soon as possible.

I am available and ready to assist whenever needed. Looking forward to
hearing from you.

Best regards,
Hunain
